test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

It was a (**easement to be far away**) from that malicious old labyrinth with its stares and gossip.
solution: The correct answer is** "relief to be away."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Easement"** means a reduction or easing of something unpleasant, so it doesn't fit in the context of wanting to be far away from the old labyrinth. (किसी अप्रिय चीज़ में कमी या सहजता, इसलिए यह पुरानी भूलभुलैया से दूर रहने की इच्छा के संदर्भ में फिट नहीं बैठता है) • **Example**: *I don't promise you any real **easement**__ for some time to come.* • **"Relief"** means a feeling of reassurance and relaxation (कष्‍ट, चिंता आदि से राहत या चैन), which fits perfectly in the context of wanting to be far away from the old labyrinth. • The correct answer is Option 2. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • Option 1,** "help to be away"**, doesn't fit in the context as it implies needing assistance to be away from the labyrinth (भूलभुलैया से दूर रहने के लिए सहायता की आवश्यकता), which is not the case in the given sentence. • Option 4, **"rest to be far"**, doesn't fit in the context as it implies needing rest when being far away from the labyrinth (भूलभुलैया से दूर होने पर आराम की आवश्यकता), which is not the case in the given sentence. 42:Tfa0, The correct answer is **"betrays."**
